byPath.*: Screens a card payment in real time: profiles the recent history of the card, detects fraud signals and scores them with a champion and a challenger strategy
byPath.Cardholder: The cardholder: home country, account opening date and known devices
byPath.FraudScore: The champion strategy: the weighted signals, the score and the action
byPath.FraudScoreChallenger: The challenger strategy: the same signals with other weights and thresholds
byPath.FraudSignals: The fired signals of the payment
byPath.HistoryStats: The profile of the recent history: counts and amounts in 1 hour, 24 hours and 30 days, and the last country
byPath.PastTransaction: A recent payment of the same card: time, amount, country and whether it was declined
byPath.PastTransactionFacts: The minutes between a past payment and the payment to screen
byPath.Transaction: The card payment to screen: time, amount, merchant category, country, device, channel, cardholder and recent history
byPath.TransactionFacts: The history profile, the 30-day average, the amount ratio, the device, country and account age signals
byPath.attackBook: A card testing attack: small declined payments, then a large online payment at night from an unknown device
byPath.challengerAction: ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK by the challenger score thresholds
byPath.challengerWeights: The weight of each signal in the challenger strategy, and the signals that block at once
byPath.championAction: ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK by the champion score thresholds
byPath.championWeights: The weight of each signal in the champion strategy, and the signals that block at once
byPath.compareStrategies: The champion and challenger scores and actions of several payments side by side
byPath.comparisonBook: Four payments scored by both strategies
byPath.comparisonBook.comparison: The scores and actions of both strategies
byPath.fraudSignals: Every fraud signal that the payment raises
byPath.historyStats: One pass over the history: counts and sums in each time window, and the country of the latest payment
byPath.screenTransaction: Screens one payment: the champion action, the signals, the challenger result in shadow mode and the history profile
